name: White hull
description: Open white boat shell with a high curved bow and empty interior.
retain: The white hull silhouette recurs in every ship state.
distinguish: No deck, mast or lantern; visibly hollow rather than a finished white boat.

name: Open deck
description: Low fitted white deck panel, shaped to the hull interior.
retain: Deck outline matches White hull and stays with the ship.
distinguish: Loose standing surface, not a complete hull or raft.

name: Striped mast
description: Red-and-white striped mast with a small triangular sail and bent yellow flag.
retain: Keep stripe sequence, triangular sail and sideways-bent flag through every descendant.
distinguish: One complete mast fitting; no hull, lamp or new flag in later states.

name: Warm bulb
description: Small warm glowing bulb with a visible base.
retain: Its warm core remains inside Warm lantern.
distinguish: Bare bulb rather than a complete glass lantern or amber harbour lamp.

name: Clear lamp globe
description: Empty clear rounded lamp housing with a small foot.
retain: Its glass housing encloses Warm bulb to form Warm lantern.
distinguish: Empty and unlit; distinct from the broad frosted Diffusing globe.

name: Display bottle
description: Broad horizontal clear bottle with neck and removable end.
retain: This exact bottle remains the middle layer before and after inversion.
distinguish: Bottle profile, not a sphere or theatre dome; entirely empty at first.

name: Decked hull
description: White hull with the low deck fitted across its opening.
retain: White hull and Open deck together.
distinguish: No mast or lantern; interior is now a usable surface.

name: Undecked striped ship
description: White hull carrying the striped mast, triangular sail and bent flag over an open interior.
retain: Original hull and complete Striped mast.
distinguish: No deck and no lantern; keep visible depth inside the hull.

name: Lit decked hull
description: Decked white hull with a warm glass lantern beside the future mast position.
retain: White hull, Open deck and Warm lantern.
distinguish: Lantern fitted but no mast, sail or flag yet.

name: Striped ship
description: White decked ship with striped mast, triangular sail and bent yellow flag.
retain: White hull, Open deck and complete Striped mast.
distinguish: Complete sailing silhouette but no lantern; distinguish from Undecked striped ship by the deck.

name: Warm lantern
description: Warm bulb enclosed by the clear lamp globe on its small foot.
retain: Warm bulb and Clear lamp globe.
distinguish: Ship lantern is small, clear and warm; harbour lantern is larger and frosted.

name: Beacon ship
description: White decked ship with striped mast, bent flag and warm lantern beside the mast.
retain: All Striped ship parts plus Warm lantern.
distinguish: No enclosing bottle; lantern stays attached to ship through inversion.

name: Bottled beacon ship
description: The complete beacon ship visible inside the broad clear bottle.
retain: Display bottle encloses Beacon ship with its deck, mast, sail, flag and lantern.
distinguish: Bottle outside ship; no harbour yet; glass must not hide the lantern.

name: Empty blue basin
description: Shallow blue model basin with clearly exposed dry floor.
retain: Same basin outline becomes Harbour basin and supports the crescent harbour.
distinguish: No water or pier; distinguish from the later long regatta basin.

name: Model seawater
description: A freestanding curled blue water volume with a visible surface and wave edge.
retain: Blue water fills the early harbour basin.
distinguish: Symbolic model-water supply, not a bottled liquid or a finished harbour.

name: Crescent pier shell
description: Bare crescent waterfront with low quay, higher landing and warehouse roof terrace across a gap.
retain: Quay, landing, gap and warehouse geometry recur in every harbour.
distinguish: No silver edging, basin or water; landing and terrace must be distinct heights/places.

name: Reflective edging
description: Thin silver curved strips fitted to the crescent waterfront contour.
retain: Silver perimeter stays on Crescent pier and all harbours.
distinguish: Separate bright trim rather than a second solid pier.

name: Harbour basin
description: Early blue basin filled with blue water, surface visibly covering its floor.
retain: Empty blue basin plus Model seawater.
distinguish: No pier or bottle yet; different outline from Mirror pool.

name: Crescent pier
description: Crescent waterfront with a silver reflective rim, quay, raised landing and warehouse terrace.
retain: Crescent pier shell plus Reflective edging.
distinguish: Finished edging, still no basin or water.

name: Crescent harbour
description: Silver-edged crescent waterfront around blue water within the early basin.
retain: Harbour basin and complete Crescent pier.
distinguish: Wet finished harbour without any bottled ship.

name: Dry crescent harbour
description: Silver-edged crescent waterfront installed in the blue basin with dry floor exposed.
retain: Empty blue basin and complete Crescent pier.
distinguish: Same harbour geometry as Crescent harbour, visibly no water.

name: Harbour around the bottled ship
description: A broad blue harbour surrounds the clear bottle holding the tiny beacon ship.
retain: Harbour outside bottle outside ship; pier belongs to harbour, mast and lamp to ship.
distinguish: Three readable nested layers in this order; no oversized outer ship.

name: Inside-out arch
description: A standing gallery arch with two opposed nested-layer diagrams marking outside-to-inside reversal.
retain: One recurring apparatus for both ship and room reversals.
distinguish: Reversal changes layer order without duplication; not the merging or copying machine.

name: Ship carrying its harbour
description: Large white beacon ship carries the same clear bottle, now containing water and the silver crescent.
retain: Ship outside bottle outside harbour; mast, sail, flag and lantern remain outside glass on ship.
distinguish: Inverted enclosure, not merely the bottled ship enlarged; bottle stays middle and is not duplicated.

name: Broad boarding deck
description: Broad low platform with a visibly hinged boarding ramp along its open edge.
retain: Deck and hinged ramp persist through every passenger-platform state.
distinguish: No rail, gate or motion; distinct from bench rafts and cork raft deck.

name: Safety rail with gate
description: Low enclosing rail with a conspicuous opening gate, shaped to the boarding deck.
retain: Rail and gate fit Broad boarding deck and remain on Harbour lift.
distinguish: No deck or bench; gate must remain identifiable after fitting.

name: Toy lift
description: Red block beside a vertical route with lower and upper marked stops and a return arrow.
retain: The red block remains the source; copied Up ribbon takes only its route.
distinguish: Exactly one upward segment; source block is red, shuttle block blue.

name: Motion comb
description: Handled comb with fine teeth drawn through a clear arrow ribbon.
retain: Reusable route-copying tool; moving source remains present.
distinguish: Copies path and stops only; not the Copy press, and no body or light appears in its ribbon.

name: Boarding platform
description: Broad boarding deck with hinged ramp, safety rail and opening gate.
retain: Broad boarding deck plus Safety rail with gate.
distinguish: Complete stationary passenger platform, no route diagram yet.

name: Rising boarding deck
description: Bare ramped boarding deck beside one upward route with two stops and return.
retain: Broad boarding deck receives Up; its ramp is unchanged.
distinguish: Moving but unrailed; must not acquire Harbour lift's rail or gate.

name: Up ribbon
description: Clear arrow ribbon showing one vertical outward segment, two marked stops and a retraced return.
retain: Exact Up geometry is reused relative to each receiver's origin.
distinguish: No source red block, body or light; no crossing or circular segment.

name: Harbour lift
description: Railed boarding platform and hinged ramp with an upward route and lower/upper stops.
retain: Boarding platform plus Up, or Rising boarding deck plus rail.
distinguish: One upward segment only; complete rail and gate distinguish it from Rising boarding deck.

name: Toy shuttle
description: Blue block on a horizontal outward route with two marked stops and return.
retain: Source route joins Up at the upper landing without scaling.
distinguish: One crossing segment; no red block, vertical path or passenger deck.

name: Across ribbon
description: Clear arrow ribbon showing one rightward crossing, endpoint stops and retraced return.
retain: Exact Across length and direction recur at each receiver's origin.
distinguish: No upward leg; labels for the source landing and terrace do not become transported places.

name: Quay-to-terrace platform
description: Railed ramped platform beside an up-then-right route with three marked stops and return.
retain: Harbour lift gains Across while retaining quay and landing stops.
distinguish: Two segments, no circle; no lantern until Light-carrying platform.

name: Amber lamp
description: Small amber lamp core sized for the broad harbour globe.
retain: Supplies the Harbour lantern's warm light.
distinguish: Bare lamp core, not an installed lantern or the ship's bulb housing.

name: Diffusing globe
description: Broad unlit frosted globe with a visible rim and soft opaque glass edge.
retain: Frosted housing stays with all harbour-light states.
distinguish: Empty and frosted, unlike Clear lamp globe or clear garden sphere.

name: Harbour lantern
description: Amber lamp inside the broad frosted globe with a warm diffuse halo.
retain: Amber lamp plus Diffusing globe.
distinguish: Stationary independent light; no platform or movement path.

name: Up-then-across ribbon
description: One diagram with vertical then rightward outward legs, three stops and full retraced return.
retain: Up followed by Across; earlier landing stop survives composition.
distinguish: Two segments only; no source platform, light or extra loop.

name: Rising harbour light
description: Broad frosted harbour lantern beside an Up route with two stops and return.
retain: Harbour lantern receives Up; all globe and lamp parts remain.
distinguish: Light alone rises; no passenger deck, crossing or circle.

name: Travelling harbour beacon
description: Broad frosted harbour lantern beside an Up-then-Across route with three stops and return.
retain: Harbour lantern retains Up and gains Across, or receives both together.
distinguish: Independent light, no platform; warm globe keeps same profile as Rising harbour light.

name: Light-carrying platform
description: Warm frosted lantern hangs visibly from the gated rail of the ramped passenger platform.
retain: Quay-to-terrace platform and its complete route plus Harbour lantern.
distinguish: One platform carries lamp and passengers together; do not show a second unlit platform.

name: Copy press
description: A recognisable press with one source recess and a separate matching output recess.
retain: Copies the complete object's fitted parts and movements while preserving the source.
distinguish: Independent full copy, not outline tracing, motion extraction or merging; no visitors copied.

name: Merging frame
description: A standing open frame with two related fork-tree inputs and one shared-fork output diagram.
retain: Combines related versions' common base once and nonconflicting additions together.
distinguish: Only this apparatus deduplicates ancestry; not an inside-out arch or ordinary join.

name: Around ribbon
description: Complete circular outward route with a marked start/finish dot, wait marker and reverse return arrow.
retain: Comet's full circuit is copied as a path through space.
distinguish: No comet or silver tail; orbiting travel rather than spinning about a fixed axle.

name: Up-then-around ribbon
description: Vertical outward leg to a marked stop, then one complete circular leg, then reverse return along both.
retain: Black puppet's Up-then-Around order and complete waits.
distinguish: No Across leg, coloured puppet, sail or light; distinct from the ray's Around-then-Up journey.

name: Forked silver stem
description: Silver trunk splitting low like an open hand, with a conspicuous notch in the left branch.
retain: Fork shape and left-branch notch persist in every tree descendant and traced outline.
distinguish: Bare sculptural stem; no leaf fan, bells, gold fans or soil.

name: Translucent leaf fan
description: Single translucent pale fan of leaves shaped to attach above the silver fork.
retain: Original foliage stays on Silver tree and all of its descendants.
distinguish: Pale starter foliage, not the later broad golden fans or yellow puppet wings.

name: Silver tree
description: Forked silver stem carrying its translucent leaf fan.
retain: Stem, left notch and starter fan.
distinguish: No bells, gold fans, planter or motion; not a living rooted tree requiring soil.

name: Silver tree copy
description: An independent, visually identical silver fork tree with the same translucent leaf fan.
retain: Complete Silver tree copied, including the left notch.
distinguish: One copy in the item image; no decorative change to imply independence and no merged twin trunk.

name: Blue luminous bellflowers
description: A hanging cluster of small blue bell-shaped glowing flowers.
retain: Downward bell silhouettes remain below the tree canopy.
distinguish: Blue flowers are lights, not broad fans or generic round bulbs.

name: Broad golden fans
description: A small set of broad gold fan leaves with clear spread ribs.
retain: Wide fan silhouettes remain above the blue bells when both are installed.
distinguish: Opaque-looking gold leaf sculptures, not yellow translucent kite wings.

name: Empty floating planter
description: Low open planter bowl with a broad rim and visibly empty centre.
retain: It supports First garden tree and all walk-through garden descendants.
distinguish: Empty hovering frame, no tree, blue border or round branch cradle.

name: Blue bellflower tree
description: Familiar forked silver tree with translucent starter foliage and blue bells hanging below.
retain: Silver tree plus blue luminous bellflowers; left notch remains exposed.
distinguish: No golden fans or planter; parent preserved for later copying.

name: Gold fan tree
description: Familiar forked silver tree with translucent starter foliage and broad golden fans above.
retain: Silver tree plus broad golden fans; left notch remains exposed.
distinguish: No blue bells or planter; same original parent later supplies lookouts and forest outline.

name: Blue-and-gold tree
description: One notched silver fork carries starter foliage, low blue bells and high broad golden fans.
retain: Merging frame combines Blue bellflower tree and Gold fan tree: common trunk and foliage once.
distinguish: One trunk, not two trees glued together; both additions clearly occupy separate zones.

name: First garden tree
description: Blue-and-gold tree seated inside the low floating planter.
retain: Complete merged tree plus Empty floating planter.
distinguish: No orbiting droplet or visiting bench yet.

name: Broad viewing raft
description: Small floating platform with a curved bench and unobstructed open front.
retain: Bench and raft travel together in all viewing-raft states.
distinguish: Already a seat, unlike the gated passenger platform; no canopy, rail or cork pontoons.

name: Clear light bead
description: Small clear white light point with a glass edge and concentrated shine.
retain: Becomes the luminous core inside Waterdrop lantern.
distinguish: Pale light source, distinct from the amber Warm light bead used by the firefly.

name: Glass droplet shell
description: Empty transparent teardrop housing with a narrow top and rounded bottom.
retain: Droplet profile encloses Clear light bead in every waterdrop state.
distinguish: Unlit hollow shell, not a sphere, bulb or firefly shape.

name: Little comet
description: Bright pebble with long silver tail beside a full circular route and marked starting dot.
retain: Its body and tail remain with the source when Around is copied.
distinguish: Moving along a ring in space, not spinning in place; tail never transfers to receivers.

name: Rising viewing raft
description: Curved-bench viewing raft beside an Up path with lower/upper stops and return.
retain: Broad viewing raft receives Up without adding parts.
distinguish: One vertical segment; no crossing yet and no passenger-platform gate.

name: Branch-height viewing raft
description: Curved-bench viewing raft beside Up-then-Across with quay, crown and terrace stops.
retain: Rising viewing raft gains Across, or Broad viewing raft receives both segments.
distinguish: Bench reaches tree-crown height then crosses; no orbit, canopy or light.

name: Waterdrop lantern
description: Clear luminous bead inside the transparent teardrop shell.
retain: Clear light bead and Glass droplet shell.
distinguish: Stationary white droplet light; no orbital route or comet tail.

name: Orbiting waterdrop lantern
description: Luminous glass teardrop travelling around a complete marked circle with reverse return.
retain: Waterdrop lantern receives Around; its droplet and clear core remain.
distinguish: One circle only, no vertical leg; no firefly wings or silver tail.

name: Garden with moving light
description: Floating blue-and-gold tree with the bright teardrop circling its canopy.
retain: First garden tree plus Orbiting waterdrop lantern.
distinguish: No visiting bench yet; does not include the low crescent garden, ray or firefly.

name: Garden with viewing raft
description: Floating blue-and-gold tree with curved-bench raft on its Up-then-Across route.
retain: First garden tree plus Branch-height viewing raft.
distinguish: Bench present, orbiting waterdrop absent; no low crescent, ray or firefly.

name: Walk-through garden
description: Tall planted blue-and-gold tree, orbiting droplet and curved-bench raft visiting crown and terrace.
retain: First garden tree plus both moving light and viewing raft, whichever order fitted.
distinguish: One high garden; low blue border and gold island have not joined yet.

name: Low crescent cradle
description: Low broad crescent planting frame with an open curved receiving channel.
retain: Frame spreads its copied tree along the low crescent and remains beneath it.
distinguish: Not the harbour's pier or a spherical cradle; no bells, water or tree initially.

name: Broad floating disc
description: Plain broad flat circular floating platform with a clear top surface.
retain: Supports Gold fan island and all its moving descendants.
distinguish: Solid disc, not a planter bowl, ring cradle or garden sphere.

name: Blue bellflower tree copy
description: An independent copy of the notched silver tree, starter foliage and low blue bells.
retain: Complete Blue bellflower tree copied without changing its original.
distinguish: Identical tree before reshaping; no crescent cradle, gold fans or motion.

name: Gold fan tree copy
description: An independent copy of the notched silver tree, starter foliage and broad gold fans.
retain: Complete Gold fan tree copied while the parent stays.
distinguish: No disc or motion yet; do not redesign the copied fork or add blue bells.

name: Blue night border
description: Copied blue bellflower tree spread low along the crescent cradle, bells hanging toward water height.
retain: Blue copy's silver fork, left notch, foliage and bells plus Low crescent cradle.
distinguish: Reshaped low border, not an upright tree; remains stationary in Moon garden.

name: Gold fan island
description: Copied gold fan tree standing on the broad floating disc.
retain: Gold fan tree copy plus Broad floating disc.
distinguish: Disc fitted but no orbital motion; no blue bells or crescent cradle.

name: Circling gold tree copy
description: Copied gold fan tree beside a full circular route with marked start and return.
retain: Gold fan tree copy receives Around; all foliage and left notch stay.
distinguish: Orbiting tree without the broad disc; no new comet tail or blue flowers.

name: Circling gold fan island
description: Gold fan tree on its broad disc travelling around a complete circle.
retain: Gold fan island plus Around, or Circling gold tree copy plus disc.
distinguish: Disc travels with tree; single circle, no vertical segment and no blue bells.

name: Moon garden
description: Stationary low blue crescent border beneath a gold fan island on its circular route.
retain: Blue night border plus complete Circling gold fan island.
distinguish: Two distinct copied trees retain their own forks; no merging and no tall blue-and-gold tree or bench.

name: Clear garden sphere
description: Empty clear spherical enclosure with an uninterrupted curved glass boundary.
retain: Encloses Pocket garden and stays with its regatta copy.
distinguish: Unfilled sphere, distinct from the bottle, theatre dome and room-supply globes.

name: Garden of two tides
description: Tall blue-and-gold garden with bench and droplet beside low blue crescent and circling gold island.
retain: Complete Walk-through garden plus complete Moon garden, with all three tree structures and routes.
distinguish: No ray or firefly yet; ordinary joining does not collapse repeated tree ancestry.

name: Pocket garden
description: Independent unglazed copy of the two-tide garden, with tall tree, bench, droplet, low border and gold island.
retain: All Garden of two tides fitted parts and independent movements copied.
distinguish: No enclosing sphere and no later ray or firefly; original full garden survives.

name: Garden sphere
description: Clear sphere enclosing the complete earlier two-tide garden and all its small moving parts.
retain: Pocket garden plus Clear garden sphere.
distinguish: Historical pre-festival garden: no ray or firefly, even when the full garden later acquires them.

name: Broad glass wings
description: Broad paired transparent wings joined at a small centre, making the ray's wide front silhouette.
retain: Wing outline remains identical in every glass ray state.
distinguish: No forked tail, light or motion; distinct from yellow puppet fans and silver gull wings.

name: Forked glass tail
description: Long clear glass tail ending in a visible two-pronged fork.
retain: Fits behind Broad glass wings and stays on the ray.
distinguish: Glass fork, not the puppet's long red ribbon or fish fan tail.

name: Circling glass wings
description: Tailless broad glass wings beside a complete circular outward route and retraced return.
retain: Broad glass wings receive Around.
distinguish: Still no tail, light or upward segment.

name: Circling-and-rising glass wings
description: Tailless glass wings with a circular outward leg followed by a vertical leg and full return.
retain: Circling glass wings gain Up after the circle; earlier stop stays.
distinguish: Around-then-Up, not Up-then-Around; tail is still absent.

name: Glass ray
description: Broad transparent wing sculpture joined to a long clear forked tail.
retain: Broad glass wings plus Forked glass tail.
distinguish: Complete stationary ray; not a luminous firefly, winged kite or gull.

name: Circling glass ray
description: Complete glass ray with forked tail on a full circular route and reverse return.
retain: Glass ray receives Around, or tail is fitted to Circling glass wings.
distinguish: One circle only; no rising leg, glow or comet tail.

name: Circling-and-rising glass ray
description: Complete glass ray on a circular route followed by an upward leg, both stops retained.
retain: Glass ray and forked tail retain Around-then-Up in either fitting order.
distinguish: Circle first, rise second; firefly does the reverse order and supplies light of its own.

name: Ray garden
description: Full two-tide garden with glass ray circling then rising below and above the fans.
retain: Garden of two tides plus Circling-and-rising glass ray; all older trees, bench, droplet and island persist.
distinguish: Ray fitted, touring firefly absent; existing orbiting droplet still remains.

name: Lantern garden
description: Full two-tide garden with warm firefly rising then circling through the leaves.
retain: Garden of two tides plus Touring firefly lantern; all older contents and routes persist.
distinguish: Firefly fitted, ray absent; do not replace the earlier waterdrop lantern.

name: Festival garden
description: Full two-tide garden with both the broad fork-tailed glass ray and warm touring firefly.
retain: All original three tree structures, planter, bench, droplet, border, island, ray and firefly with their own routes.
distinguish: Ray Around-then-Up and firefly Up-then-Around stay distinct; no stage or enclosing sphere.

name: Pocket festival garden
description: Independent unglazed copy of the complete festival garden, including ray and warm firefly.
retain: Complete Festival garden copied with all fitted parts and movements.
distinguish: Later copy differs materially from Pocket garden and Garden sphere; no theatre dome or puppet stage.

name: Split-diamond puppet frame
description: Dark open diamond frame with a split at the lower point and clear side/tail fitting points.
retain: Diamond outline and lower split stay through all glass-kite descendants.
distinguish: Empty centre, no blue film, wings, tail, light or route.

name: Blue translucent film
description: Thin blue translucent sheet with a folded corner and light visible through it.
retain: Fills the diamond frame without concealing its dark edge.
distinguish: Coloured transparent material, not black tracing film or a glowing light source.

name: Blue glass kite
description: Dark split-diamond frame filled with blue translucent film.
retain: Split-diamond puppet frame plus Blue translucent film.
distinguish: Stationary, wingless and tailless; blue comes from transparency rather than emitted light.

name: Rising empty kite frame
description: Open split-diamond frame beside an Up route with two stops and return.
retain: Bare frame receives Up without gaining any film.
distinguish: Moving but visibly hollow; no blue infill, wings or tail.

name: Rising glass kite
description: Blue-filled split-diamond frame beside the vertical Up route.
retain: Blue glass kite plus Up, or Rising empty kite frame plus blue film.
distinguish: One rise only; no wing fans, red tail or crossing.

name: Rising glass kite copy
description: Independent identical blue split-diamond kite with its copied Up route.
retain: Complete Rising glass kite copied, including motion and lower split.
distinguish: Same appearance and route as parent, no extra decorations; one copy represented.

name: Lit sail screen
description: Broad taut white sail with a narrow lamp beam directed across its face.
retain: Sail and illuminating lamp remain the basis of every stage and stage copy.
distinguish: No blue crescent or puppets yet; external lamp supplies projected light.

name: Yellow translucent wing fans
description: Two broad yellow translucent fan wings with ribs and visible paired attachment roots.
retain: Pair fits the sides of the blue diamond and remains on coloured performer.
distinguish: Yellow wings for puppet, not gold tree leaves; do not attach to tailed black performer.

name: Long red tail
description: Long curling ribbon of translucent red film with one attachment end.
retain: Tail stays on Tailed kite, opaque traced shape and luminous regatta descendant.
distinguish: Translucent red ribbon, not a forked glass tail, fan tail or comet trail.

name: Black tracing film
description: Flat opaque black sheet with a lifted edge suggesting its thinness.
retain: Takes a shape-only independent outline from Tailed kite.
distinguish: Opacity blocks light; tracing copies neither motion nor the source's material/colour.

name: Winged kite
description: Blue split-diamond kite with two yellow fan wings and its retained Up route.
retain: Rising glass kite or its copy plus paired yellow wings.
distinguish: Broad blue-and-gold performer, no red tail; crossing has not been appended yet.

name: Tailed kite
description: Blue split-diamond kite with long translucent red tail and its retained Up route.
retain: Rising glass kite or its copy plus Long red tail.
distinguish: No yellow wings; glass parent continues rising after Black kite is traced.

name: Crossing glass kite
description: Blue diamond and paired yellow fans beside Up-then-Across with three stops.
retain: Winged kite gains Across while keeping Up and both wings.
distinguish: Coloured winged performer, no tail or circular route; does not emit its own light.

name: Black kite
description: Flat opaque black diamond with the long tail silhouette of the glass parent.
retain: Tailed kite's diamond, lower split and tail shape traced independently.
distinguish: Stationary outline: no Up inherited, no blue/gold/red transparency, no wings or light.

name: Blue crescent panel
description: Low translucent crescent panel edged in blue light.
retain: Fits across the lower white sail and remains in later stages.
distinguish: Stage scenery panel, not a three-dimensional pier, planter or blue night border.

name: Rising black kite
description: Opaque tailed diamond beside an Up route with two stops and return.
retain: Black kite receives Up; all silhouette details remain.
distinguish: One rise only; no circle yet, no wings and no transmitted colour.

name: Rising-and-circling black kite
description: Opaque tailed diamond beside vertical-then-circular route with marked stops and full reverse return.
retain: Rising black kite gains Around after its rise.
distinguish: Up-then-Around only, never Up-Across-Around; still dark rather than luminous.

name: Harbour stage
description: White sail and narrow lamp with the low luminous blue crescent across the sail.
retain: Lit sail screen plus Blue crescent panel; shared registration for later stage states.
distinguish: Empty stage with no performers or garden; becomes a fixed receiving place in the next chapter.

name: Glass firefly shell
description: Small transparent firefly-shaped housing with a clear empty light chamber.
retain: Shell silhouette remains in stationary and touring firefly states.
distinguish: Unlit empty shell; not a droplet, ray or already-glowing creature.

name: Warm light bead
description: Small warm amber luminous bead sized for the firefly chamber.
retain: Provides the firefly's light independently of its borrowed route.
distinguish: Warm point source, not the clear white droplet bead or a motion ribbon.

name: Clear theatre dome
description: Empty clear dome sized to cover the complete miniature sail stage.
retain: Dome encloses Pocket stage and remains on Theatre globe and blue-hour version.
distinguish: Dome enclosure, not the garden sphere, bottle or an already installed stage.

name: Firefly lantern
description: Warm luminous bead enclosed in the small glass firefly shell.
retain: Glass firefly shell plus Warm light bead.
distinguish: Lit but stationary; no puppet silhouette, silver tail or route inherited from the bead.

name: Touring empty firefly shell
description: Clear unlit firefly shell beside the Up-then-Around route and full retraced return.
retain: Glass firefly shell receives the two-segment ribbon.
distinguish: Motion present but warm bead absent; copying a dark puppet's route supplies no light.

name: Touring firefly lantern
description: Warm glowing glass firefly on a rise-then-circle route with waits and return.
retain: Shell, warm bead and Up-then-Around, whichever fitted first.
distinguish: Light comes from bead; no dark puppet body, wings of the ray or Across leg.

name: Coloured-puppet stage
description: Registered blue-crescent sail stage with the blue-and-gold winged kite crossing after its rise.
retain: Harbour stage plus complete Crossing glass kite and its route.
distinguish: Only the coloured performer; no black tailed puppet or garden.

name: Black-puppet stage
description: Registered blue-crescent sail stage with the opaque tailed kite rising then circling.
retain: Harbour stage plus complete Rising-and-circling black kite and its route.
distinguish: Only the black performer; no coloured wings or garden.

name: Two-puppet harbour stage
description: Registered sail and blue crescent with winged coloured performer and dark tailed performer on separate routes.
retain: Both stage performers, lamp and blue crescent, in either installation order.
distinguish: Coloured Up-then-Across versus black Up-then-Around; no garden backdrop yet.

name: Pocket stage
description: Portable independent miniature of the sail, lamp, blue crescent and both moving puppets.
retain: Complete Two-puppet harbour stage copied, including each performer's own route.
distinguish: No dome and no later garden; fixed original stays installed.

name: Theatre globe
description: Clear dome enclosing the early two-puppet sail stage and blue crescent.
retain: Pocket stage plus Clear theatre dome.
distinguish: Historical pre-garden copy; no festival trees, ray or firefly inside it.

name: Living garden play
description: Registered two-puppet sail stage with the full copied festival garden behind its performers.
retain: Two-puppet harbour stage plus Pocket festival garden; retain sail, lamp, crescent and both routes.
